meta.footEn: Data snapshot: 2026-08-22 · Garmin fenix 8 via Freddy

en.c5d: computed from sleep, HRV, RHR, stress & recent load
en.rec: Last night — Friday evening into this Saturday morning — is the best night on the board: lights out 00:01, up at 06:47, 6h 41m asleep inside 6h 46m in bed. The score is 89, the highest of the seven (84, 81, 76, 83, 79, 76, 89) and 13 clear of Thursday's 76. Garmin graded every component excellent except total duration, which it calls fair — and that is the one genuine soft spot: 6h 41m sits 9 minutes under the 6h 50m seven-night average, and a midnight bedtime is the reason. Everything about the quality of those hours was outstanding. Deep sleep hit 119 minutes, 30% of the night and the deepest reading of the window by 24 minutes over Thursday's 95. REM recovered to 96 minutes from Thursday's washed-out 49. Awake time collapsed to 5 minutes from 20, putting efficiency at 99% — the cleanest, least fragmented night of the seven. The autonomic markers moved together and they moved hard. HRV came in at 50, up 14 overnight from 36 and 8 above the 42 average — the highest reading of the window and the first time it has cleared 47 since Monday. RHR dropped to 50, four under last night and three under the 53 average, breaking below the 53–55 band that has held every single night of the window. Average overnight stress read 10, against 27 the night before and 25–37 across the rest of the week — not a marginal improvement but a different order of magnitude. Readiness lands at 89, very good, held just short of the top band only by the short duration. Practically: this is a green light. Two nights ago the advice was to wait for recovery data before touching a trap-bar deadlift — the data has now arrived and it is emphatic. The posterior chain has had Thursday's hack squat plus a swim day and two nights behind it, and this morning's numbers say the system is charged. The one thing to fix is the bedtime; hold the wake time and move lights-out from 00:01 back toward 23:00 and the duration flag disappears without costing anything else.

hr.c4d: +14 vs prethodna noć (36) · +8 vs prosjek 7 noći (42)
hr.c5d: izračunato iz sna, HRV-a, RHR-a, stresa i opterećenja
hr.rec: Sinoć — večer petka do jutros u subotu — najbolja je noć na ploči: gašenje svjetla u 00:01, ustajanje u 06:47, 6h 41m sna unutar 6h 46m u krevetu. Ocjena je 89, najviša od sedam (84, 81, 76, 83, 79, 76, 89) i punih 13 iznad četvrtkovih 76. Garmin je svaku sastavnicu ocijenio izvrsnom osim ukupnog trajanja, koje naziva osrednjim — i to je jedina stvarna slaba točka: 6h 41m je 9 minuta ispod sedmodnevnog prosjeka od 6h 50m, a razlog je odlazak na spavanje u ponoć. Sve ostalo o kvaliteti tih sati bilo je vrhunsko. Duboki san dosegnuo je 119 minuta, 30% noći i najdublje očitanje u prozoru, 24 minute iznad četvrtkovih 95. REM se oporavio na 96 minuta s četvrtkovih ispranih 49. Budnost je pala na 5 minuta s 20, pa je učinkovitost 99% — najčišća, najmanje isprekidana noć od sedam. Autonomni pokazatelji pomaknuli su se zajedno i pomaknuli su se snažno. HRV je iznosio 50, 14 više nego prethodne noći (36) i 8 iznad prosjeka od 42 — najviše očitanje u prozoru i prvi put iznad 47 od ponedjeljka. RHR je pao na 50, četiri ispod sinoćnjeg i tri ispod prosjeka od 53, probivši se ispod raspona 53–55 koji je držao svaku noć u prozoru. Prosječni noćni stres iznosio je 10, naspram 27 prethodne noći i 25–37 kroz ostatak tjedna — to nije rubno poboljšanje nego drugi red veličine. Spremnost je 89, vrlo dobra, a od najvišeg razreda dijeli je samo kratko trajanje. Praktično: ovo je zeleno svjetlo. Prije dva dana savjet je bio pričekati podatke o oporavku prije trap-bar mrtvog dizanja — podaci su sada stigli i nedvosmisleni su. Stražnji lanac iza sebe ima četvrtkov hack čučanj, plivački dan i dvije noći, a jutrošnji brojevi kažu da je sustav napunjen. Jedino što treba popraviti je vrijeme lijeganja; zadrži vrijeme buđenja i pomakni gašenje svjetla s 00:01 prema 23:00 i oznaka za trajanje nestaje bez ikakve druge cijene.
